title: Kit gallery
subtitle: Every kit component in every state. Pages build only from these.
sec.buttonsDesc: Every button is one square plate with its bottom corner cut. A view has one primary button, the accent plate; every other kind is the grey plate, and the danger tone is the grey plate in the danger colour. Each column is one kind, named on the button. The rows are the sizes, then the states at the medium size. Under them: the marks and labels a button can carry.
sec.iconButtonsDesc: Every icon-only button has a tooltip with its name and, when it has one, its shortcut. A ghost one has no frame until the pointer is on it, except in a toolbar. The columns are ghost, secondary, primary and danger. The rows are the sizes, then the states at the medium size.

sec.buttonMarksDesc: A primary or secondary button ends with a mark: the arrow, the plus for a label that starts with New, or one the button names. A button like Cancel leaves it out. A start icon shows only on a button without the end mark.
